meta.title: Adding a price field adds a column, and an added one cannot be added twice
gaps: The catalog cannot record the initial total column count and assert that the final count is exactly one greater.
No supplied template guarantees GST is initially available to add; the plan checks this prerequisite rather than assuming it.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The catalog cannot record the initial total column count and assert that the final count is exactly one greater.; No supplied template guarantees GST is initially available to add; the plan checks this prerequisite rather than assuming it.

steps.note: Use the default Auction pricing stage.
Supply the required unique project title.
Verify the initial sheet headers have rendered.
Require GST to be absent before adding it; an existing GST column would invalidate this setup.
Open the price-field menu using the case's unconfirmed label.
Verify the chosen field is available for its first addition.
Assert that the previously absent field now has a sheet column.
Reopen the same menu to inspect duplicate prevention.
Assert the added field remains present rather than disappearing.
Assert the existing field cannot be added again.
